article.headline: Wilkinson puts up 24 as South Dakota State takes down Omaha 84-69
article.description: — Damon Wilkinson scored 24 points as South Dakota State beat Omaha 84-69 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Wilkinson puts up 24 as South Dakota State takes down Omaha 84-69

categories.description: Omaha Mavericks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

event.description: Omaha Mavericks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

keywords: Omaha Mavericks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits
article.story: BROOKINGS, S.D. -- — Damon Wilkinson scored 24 points as South Dakota State beat Omaha 84-69 on Thursday. Wilkinson also contributed 19 rebounds and three blocks for the Jackrabbits (8-8, 1-0 Summit League). Matthew Mors went 7 of 11 from the field to add 16 points. Joe Sayler shot 5 for 12, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc, to finish with 14 points. Paul Djobet led the way for the Mavericks (7-9, 0-1) with 22 points and three steals. Omaha also got 14 points from Julian Margrave. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
